text: I successfully set up the CopilotKit runtime endpoint, which demonstrably works: `curl http://localhost:3000/api/copilotkit/info` returns HTTP 200 with valid JSON showing `{"version":"1.73.3","agents":{"default":{"name":"default","className":"BuiltInAgent"...}}}`. However, the Next.js frontend page is stuck in compilation (`○ Compiling / ...`) and never responds, so the full app does not serve. I had to deviate from the docs by changing the model string from `"openai:gpt-5.4-mini"` (which does not exist) to `"openai:gpt-4o-mini"`, and no real OpenAI API key was present in the sandbox environment.
